policy: Single source of truth for Unfire product names, families, editions, release status and evidence. Every public claim must be backed by an evidence entry. Store facts were checked against the public store page on the date given. Entries with listed=false are tracked to prevent duplicates and accidental publication; they are never rendered on public hubs. Families follow 20261122_UNFIRE_MASTER_BRAND_WEB_ARCHITECTURE_v1_PRIVATE (editorial labels, not subsidiaries); store states reconciled with 07_appstore_connect_versiones_20261122.
